presentation.title: Interview Presentation for Graduate Cloud Engineer

slides.heading: Candidate Introduction
bullets: IT graduate seeking a first graduate role with background as a Graduate Data Analyst.
slides.speakerNotes: Hello, my name is Fictional Acceptance Candidate. I am an IT graduate seeking my first graduate role.

slides.heading: Technical Project Experience
bullets: Developed an Academic Sales Dashboard as a Student Developer using SQL and Python.
Queried sample sales data with SQL and prepared charts for an academic project.
slides.speakerNotes: In my academic sales dashboard project, I worked with SQL and Python to query sample sales data and prepare a chart.

slides.heading: Core Skills and Context
bullets: Applied skills in SQL and Python during academic coursework.
Academic project used synthetic data with no commercial outcomes or cloud deployment.
slides.speakerNotes: My foundational skills include SQL and Python. My project focused on academic synthetic data without commercial outcomes or cloud deployment.

slides.heading: Role Alignment and Honestly Calibrated Gaps
bullets: Applying for the Graduate Cloud Engineer position to transition my programming and data skills.
Acknowledging that my current experience lacks AWS deployment, Terraform, and Kubernetes operations.
slides.speakerNotes: For the Graduate Cloud Engineer role, I want to be transparent about my background. While I bring Python and SQL experience from my academic dashboard project, I honestly acknowledge that I do not yet have hands-on experience with AWS deployment, Terraform infrastructure, or Kubernetes operations.
